verses.text: A Psalm of David. An utterance of YHWH to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”

segments.text: A Psalm of David. An utterance of YHWH to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”

verses.text: YHWH sends forth the rod of your strength from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies!”

segments.text: YHWH sends forth the rod of your strength from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies!”

verses.text: Your people [are] freewill offerings in the day of your might, in the splendors of holiness; from the womb of the morning, the dew of your youth [is] unto you.

segments.text: Your people [are] freewill offerings in the day of your might, in the splendors of holiness; from the womb of the morning, the dew of your youth [is] unto you.

verses.text: YHWH has sworn, and He will not change His mind: “You [are] a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

segments.text: YHWH has sworn, and He will not change His mind: “You [are] a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

verses.text: My Lord [is] at Your right hand; he will shatter kings in the day of his anger;

segments.text: My Lord [is] at Your right hand; he will shatter kings in the day of his anger;

verses.text: He will judge among the nations, he will fill it with corpses; he will wound the head of many lands;

segments.text: He will judge among the nations, he will fill it with corpses; he will wound the head of many lands;

verses.text: from the brook by the way He will drink. By this He will lift up the head.

segments.text: from the brook by the way He will drink. By this He will lift up the head.
